notes.title: Demo & Steam Page Now Live!
notes.content:
[h1][b]Demo & Steam Page Now Live! [/b][/h1][p][/p][p]Step into the world of reclaimed goods and see if you have an eye for hidden gems in [i]Salvage Shop Simulator[/i]![/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="wKj6DuylaJM;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]Our [b]free single-player demo[/b] is now available - and the [b]official Steam page is live[/b]![/p][p]In this vertical slice, you'll:[/p][list][*][p]Join your first [b]container auction
[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Search through salvaged items and [b]bid against NPCs
[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Clean and appraise[/b] what you win
[/p][/*][*][p][b]Sell items[/b] in your shop and set your own prices
[/p][/*][*][p]Learn the [b]core gameplay loop[/b] of acquiring, trading and growing your business!

[/p][/*][/list][p]Each container has been [b]pulled from the water[/b], and you only get [b]10 seconds[/b] to peek before bidding starts. Can you spot the treasure in the trash?[/p][p]Reinvest your earnings, [b]upgrade your store[/b], and build your reputation as a top-tier salesperson.[/p][p][/p][p]Try the demo now and wishlist [i]Salvage Shop Simulator[/i]!
Time to turn trash into treasure: 
[b]Please remember that the Demo is an early alpha version of the game and may contain significant bugs.[/b]
[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3555500/Salvage_Shop_Simulator/"][/dynamiclink][/p]
